title: Canonical Distribution Artifact Manifest
description: Schema-versioned, framed, collision-resistant manifest for a macOS .app bundle or Sparkle update archive. Records every file, symlink, directory, embedded extension, and framework with SHA-256 digests. The manifest_digest covers the entire artifact tree — any byte change to any file produces a different digest.

artifact_kind.description: Kind of distribution artifact. Supported values: unsigned_app, signed_app, notarization_submission, stapled_app, sparkle_update_archive.

bundle_identifier_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of the bundle identifier, prefixed with 'sha256:'. Excludes the raw identifier for content-light safety.

items.description: Every filesystem entry in the artifact, sorted by relative_path. Includes files, symlinks, directories, embedded extensions, and frameworks.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the artifact root, with forward-slash separators.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of file content (sha256:hex). Null for directories and symlinks.

size.description: File size in bytes. Null for directories and symlinks.

symlink_target.description: Target path of the symlink. Null for non-symlinks.

is_executable.description: Whether the file has any executable permission bit set.

significance.description: Heuristic significance class: critical (MacOS binary), meta (Info.plist), icon (icon resources), config (plist files), normal (everything else).

embedded_extension_digest.description: Identity digest of the embedded .appex extension, if present.

entitlement_summary_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the entitlements plist, if provided.

manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical JSON serialization of this manifest (manifest_digest field excluded from hash input). Any file change produces a different digest.
